messages:
maria.support: FYI — AcmeCorp (EU tenant) just opened a legal request. They say audit logs for Mar 12 10:00-11:30 UTC are incomplete and want a full export + proof of who accessed the KMS keys during that window. They mentioned possible downstream notice. Can security/legal own scope and next steps? cc @kevin.security @anna.legal :eyes:
kevin.security: Thanks, Maria. Need quick answers: 1) Is Acme on Hosted or Private? 2) Which service endpoints/region (eu-west-1?) 3) Do they use customer-managed KMS/HSM or our managed keys? If HSM, we'll need a compliance ticket to pull hardware logs.
maria.support: Acme is Hosted, region eu-west-1, using our managed KMS (not customer-managed). Case ID #AC-9982. They attached their request PDF.
opsbot: Incident link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/AC-9982 - retention window flagged: 2026-03-12 10:00:00 to 2026-03-12 11:30:00 UTC.
anna.legal: Quick flag — before exporting anything, confirm we have the DPA/SDPA with their org and whether they requested data for a legal/regulatory audit or for internal troubleshooting. If legal, we should route through Privacy & Legal and redact PII unless explicitly requested. Also we need a copy of their formal request and the legal contact.
sam.eng: For the audit export we can run the standard audit-export job against the eu logs. Sketch of commands we usually run for hosted customers:
```
# export audit events
python tools/audit_export.py --tenant acmecorp --region eu-west-1 --start "2026-03-12T10:00:00Z" --end "2026-03-12T11:30:00Z" --output s3://redwood-exports/acme/AC-9982/
# fetch KMS key access events
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/abcd-efgh --start-time 2026-03-12T10:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-12T11:30:00Z
```
Note: export can be collected within the hour but full verification + packaging for legal takes longer. Also HSM syslogs are separate and need compliance sign-off (not the case here since they use our managed KMS).
josh.cs: I can coordinate comms with Acme. We should set expectations: 24-48h for raw export, 72h for a redacted package reviewed by legal. I will prepare a customer-facing timeline once we confirm scope.
kevin.security: Sounds right. Since it's our managed KMS, we can produce CloudTrail KMS events and signer metadata. We'll include a signed statement of custody for the exported logs. I'll own the security validation. Action items: 1) Engineering run export (sam.eng) 2) Legal review of package (anna.legal) 3) CS customer timeline (josh.cs) 4) Security attest and package signing (kevin.security). ETA proposal: raw export available in ~12-24h, legal-reviewed bundle in ~48-72h.
maria.support: I have Acme's signed DPA on file and uploaded the formal written request to the case. They explicitly asked for all audit events + KMS access logs. They also asked whether we can include the service's request IDs to help correlate.
anna.legal: Good — proceed but redact internal IPs and any third-party customer identifiers. Provide a cover letter describing what is included and our redaction policy. Do not include cryptographic material (no key material or private key exports).
kevin.security: Confirmed. Also: we should include a short integrity checksum for the bundle and a timeline of steps we took to gather data. I'll prepare the custody statement template.
sam.eng: Kicked off job now (job id job-4521). Export path: s3://redwood-exports/acme/AC-9982/export-20260312.tar.gz. I expect the first dump by 1801242000 (UTC). Will post status here.
josh.cs: Ok I'll tell Acme: "We will deliver an initial raw export within 24 hours, followed by a legal-reviewed bundle within 72 hours. We will redact internal IPs and not include key material."
maria.support: Thank you all — please add any blockers. If legal needs extended hold or extra approvals, ping me.
kevin.security: No blockers foreseen. Security will review the bundle as soon as sam posts it. I will add a short statement about KMS access events and the absence of any direct HSM key exports. Will follow up with the custody statement in this thread. :white_check_mark:
anna.legal: I'll review once posted. If anything sensitive is present we may request additional redaction before sending to the customer.
sam.eng: Export complete and uploaded, checksum: sha256:3b5e9f1a... Location above. Started verification.
kevin.security: Verified integrity and KMS events included. Preparing custody attestation.
josh.cs: Drafted customer email, will share for legal review.
maria.support: Closing internal loop — I'll update Acme after legal sign-off. Thanks everyone.
